continuity: Taekyung reunites with Cheongpung and the Slaughter Saint after several months; Cheongpung continues to address Taekyung as Benefactor.
Bow Saint recognizes the Slaughter Saint, whose identity is revealed to the group; he is a peer from her past and acts to set the changed world right.
The Slaughter Saint and Cheongpung, not Great Sir, defeated the ten thousand monsters; the Slaughter Saint spent nearly two days stopping Dark Heaven’s pursuit.
The group escapes the wilderness with a black-robed captive bound in rope and reaches a large lake, where Gung Gibang’s group awaits.
Great Sir gives her name as Soonja and calls Cheongpung a spirited young man.
plot: Cheongpung and the Slaughter Saint reunite with Taekyung’s group. The Slaughter Saint forces the group to move, subdues Jeong Hogun, and is recognized by Bow Saint; Great Sir calls herself Soonja and befriends Cheongpung. The Slaughter Saint repeatedly leaves to stop Dark Heaven’s pursuers. After nearly two days, the group escapes the wilderness with a captured black-robed man and reaches a lakeside camp, where Gung Gibang and other beggars are waiting.
translation_decisions: Render 순자 as Soonja, the name Great Sir gives herself in this chapter.
Retain Cheongpung’s established address “Benefactor” for Taekyung and translate 아주머니 as “Auntie” when Cheongpung addresses Soonja.

active_continuity: Taekyung’s group reunited with Cheongpung and the Slaughter Saint after several months.
Bow Saint recognizes the Slaughter Saint, who acts to set the changed world right.
The Slaughter Saint and Cheongpung defeated the ten thousand monsters; the Slaughter Saint stopped Dark Heaven’s pursuit over nearly two days.
The group reached a large lake with Gung Gibang’s group and brought a bound black-robed captive.
open_questions: Who is the black-robed captive, and what does he know?
What is the connection between Soonja and the Slaughter Saint?
What does Bow Saint mean by setting everything right?
What happened to the Great Sir’s boy companion?
What awaits Taekyung’s group at the lakeside camp?
